inputs.value:
Cinematic dark-fantasy portrait of one young woman, framed from the waist up and
centered, facing the camera at eye level. She has very long, straight silver-white
hair, fine strands lifted by a breeze across her shoulders and chest. Pale porcelain
skin, delicate features, amber-red eyes ringed with soft crimson makeup, two thin
dried-red streaks running down from the inner corners of her eyes, glossy muted-red
lips, a calm unblinking gaze. Her head is crowned by an arc of bleached animal
vertebrae, a curved spinal band with small rib projections, interwoven with clusters
of deep red maple-like leaves and a small bone skull ornament at the top center.
A black ribbon choker crosses her throat, pinned with a single dark red flower.
She wears an asymmetric white kimono-style robe with black lapels and fine gold crane
and floral embroidery, layered over a black patterned outer garment with a dark
armored trim on one shoulder. In the lower foreground her hands grip a long horizontal
spear shaft: one hand in a deep red fabric glove, the other in a black leather glove
with long pointed claw tips. The shaft is black and white with silver spearheads at
both ends and a smear of wet dark red blood along its length. Behind her, thrown out
of focus, a colossal bleached whale-like skeleton arcs across the frame, its spine and
rib comb receding into fog. Dark gray stone vault and drifting haze fill the background
edges, with small red petals suspended in the air. Cool desaturated light, a soft
frontal key on her face, subtle rim light on the hair, shallow depth of field, fine
film grain and photoreal 3D-render surface detail. No lettering, no logo
